title: South Korea Funds $3.5B Homegrown Frontier AI Model

tickers.name: SK hynix Inc. American Depositary Shares

summary:
A domestic high-end artificial intelligence system will be developed starting in March 2027 through a partnership of public and private capital. The project will utilize $3.5 billion to build a homegrown frontier model, an effort intended to establish technological independence and sovereign capability in AI development.

The project is part of a larger strategy involving nearly $900 billion in investments over a decade targeting AI, robotics, and semiconductor factories through companies like Samsung and SK Hynix. To ensure a pipeline of domestic talent for this infrastructure, South Korea has integrated coding, facial recognition, and robotics into the primary school curriculum to compete with the U.S. and China.
